task.title: Add + button to directives in VSCode plugin similar to TASKS which triggers festina-directive
task.description: Add a + button to the DIRECTIVES section header in the VSCode extension, matching the pattern already established by KANBAN TASKS and QUICKS sections. Clicking the button should run /festina-directive in a terminal.
task.problem: The DIRECTIVES section in the VSCode extension lacks a quick way to create new directives. Users must manually create directive XML files or use the command palette, unlike TASKS and QUICKS sections which have convenient [+] header buttons. This inconsistency makes directive creation less discoverable and more friction-heavy than it needs to be.
task.value: Consistent UX across all sections in the sidebar. Users can create directives the same way they create tasks and quicks - by clicking the + button on the section header. This reduces friction for workflow customization and makes the directive creation feature more discoverable.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the DIRECTIVES section is visible in the VSCode sidebar When the user looks at the section header Then a [+] button is visible (matching TASKS and QUICKS pattern)
Given the user clicks the [+] button on the DIRECTIVES header When the click is registered Then a terminal opens and runs /festina-directive command
Given the /festina-directive command completes successfully When the new directive file is created Then the DIRECTIVES section refreshes to show the new directive
